When he led a team of [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Korren Starchaser]] found a set of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] '''statues''' within a large [[The Gulch|cave]] in one of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the [[Serianan Belt]]. Starchaser postulated that they had been created by a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Theoretical Serias species|species]].
